title: How is all these AI hentai games done?
author: Born-East7192
selftext: Hey everyone, so I have seen tons of interesting 18+ hentai games on Steam and I would like to try to do one myself, problem is I know absolutely nothing about AI or where do I even begin. And considering most AI tools won't work with 18+ stuff my best bet was coming here and asking you guys. Would anyone help me and explain the process and tools and how can I get started?

comments.author: Sirramza
comments.body: You can do it with a local model. Or you can code most of the game with Claude Code and then program/add the hentai stuff or just do it with a local model.

replies.author: Born-East7192
replies.body: Which model should I use? I'm installing comfyUI right now, and I have 16gb of vram, gpt is helping me out but he won't spill the beans on the 18+ hentai stuff.

replies.author: erofamiliar
replies.body: My personal recommendation would be SDXL Illustrious / WAI-Illustrious, or that circlestone labs Anima. Anima understands prompts better IMO, but SDXL Illustrious has a huge ecosystem

replies.author: Dankenweenie
replies.body: Gives new meaning to "single-handedly making a game with AI"

replies.author: ThreeDMK
replies.body: Best comment and follow up I have seen today.  o7

comments.body: Havign a beefy graphics card and gettign the AI that won't do it setup loacl AI so then you can make local AI be the sketchy unfiltered one

replies.body:
NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU with 8 GB of VRAM.  
Can I use this ? Do I have to buy a rig just for this?

replies.body: Can i use AI to lewd the demon tho?

comments.author: EdOfO
comments.body:
A very expensive beefy computer you can run models yourself or renting a cloud server to run them for you.  

You'd do better trying to make an "interesting" game without adult content first then adding the adult part at the end. Save you a loooot of trouble. Paying for uncensored LLMs and diffusion models is like trying out for the Olympics before you know how to walk.

comments.author: ThreeDMK
comments.body:
I mean, you can just build a relationship simulator and keep everything above board, make the content something you can edit/manage outside of the game, and then use local models to get, creative.  Local model + MCP + blender.  

Not that I would know what that would entail, but local models allow you to do all the things that Claude/OpenAI actively prevent you from doing.  qwen3 + playwright behind an API as a proxy is an incredibly fun toy to play with.

comments.author: kokutouchichi
comments.body:
Having made many adult ai games myself you make the game and switch out the stuff to make it adult after or just don't tell the LLM it's adult.

I made a game called creampie crusader for a jam on itch, as far as thr LLM knows i made a game about shooting milk from the rooftop onto people walking below.
